verdict.rationale: cubic runs several event-triggered background automations once installed and configured. It reviews new PRs automatically, auto-approves low-risk PRs after a shadow-mode trial, resolves threads when findings are fixed, checks PRs against linked Linear/Jira issues, and keeps the wiki current through a rolling PR. These are fixed, built-in behaviors that a user toggles or tunes, not automations the user designs. missing for 10: user-defined automation workflows beyond built-in review behaviors, recurring/scheduled jobs (e.g., scheduled codebase scans), independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
